name: music_ab_waveforms
description: A/B test: compare our engine output to Strudel reference for basic waveforms
script: announce A/B WAVEFORM TEST — requires ref server on port 9998
strudel edit "c4 c4 c4 c4".pianoroll() cps=0.5
notify {SCRIPT} "SINE: ref=ref_wave-sine.wav ours=ab_ours_sine.wav — analyze and callback" ["pass","fail","skip"] {inspect} blocking
strudel edit "c4 c4 c4 c4".s("sawtooth").pianoroll() cps=0.5
notify {SCRIPT} "SAWTOOTH: ref=ref_wave-sawtooth.wav ours=ab_ours_sawtooth.wav — analyze and callback" ["pass","fail","skip"] {inspect} blocking
strudel edit "c4 c4 c4 c4".s("square").pianoroll() cps=0.5
notify {SCRIPT} "SQUARE: ref=ref_wave-square.wav ours=ab_ours_square.wav — analyze and callback" ["pass","fail","skip"] {inspect} blocking
strudel edit "c4 c4 c4 c4".s("triangle").pianoroll() cps=0.5
notify {SCRIPT} "TRIANGLE: ref=ref_wave-triangle.wav ours=ab_ours_triangle.wav — analyze and callback" ["pass","fail","skip"] {inspect} blocking
